First release of this personal-use fork of [iskrin/pocketlock](https://github.com/iskrin/pocketlock), based on upstream **1.4**. Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/riap0526/pocketlock/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## New in this fork

- **Battery indicator on the lock screen** (optional, Appearance → Battery): the icon's fill shows the remaining charge, so it reads even with the percentage hidden; lightning bolt and a separate fill color while charging; free positioning, size and colors.
- **Ignore buttons after unlock** (Options, default 250 ms): after the third press the lock screen stays up briefly and ignores buttons, so an extra press does not reach the app below (e.g. ES-DE launching a game on the unlocking A press).
- **Apps never stopped** (Options): apps that are only paused, never stopped, while locked — all RetroArch variants by default; add others such as ES-DE.

## Fixes and improvements

- More reliable detection of emulators that keep running behind the lock screen (Android 11+ package visibility).
- Anti-lockout fix: analog triggers only count as an unlock method once one has actually been pressed.
- Background image decoded only as large as the screen needs and prepared in advance.

## From upstream

- 1.3: configurable unlock buttons, D-pad (HAT axis) support, screen-tap and analog-trigger toggles, anti-lockout fallback.
- 1.4: apps stopped while locked are handed back without the system's slide animation.
- Not included from 1.4: the top bar (clock + battery) and the related system-bar timing change; the early resume of stopped apps is kept to avoid a black flash after unlocking.

## Install

Download **PocketLock-1.4-fork.15.apk** below, or use [Add to Obtainium](https://github.com/riap0526/pocketlock#readme) for updates.

> This fork is signed with a different key than the original releases. Switching from the original app requires uninstalling it first, which deletes all Pocket Lock settings; if the device administrator permission is enabled, turn it off before uninstalling.
